s3.ptxt: Remove any dirt and foreign matter from the oil filter installation surface on the engine.
Apply a light coat of engine oil to the O-ring of a new oil filter.
Using SST, install the oil filter.

s2.ptxt: When not using a torque wrench

s3.ptxt: Remove any dirt and foreign matter from the oil filter installation surface on the engine.
Apply a light coat of engine oil to the O-ring of a new oil filter.
Tighten it by hand until the O-ring contacts the installation surface.
Using SST, tighten it an additional 3/4 turn.

s2.ptxt: Warm up the engine, stop it, and after 5 minutes inspect that the oil level is between the L and F marks on the oil level gauge. If the oil level is low, inspect for leaks and add oil up to the F mark.
Start the engine and check that there are no oil leaks from the oil filter and oil pan drain plug joints.

s-1.ptxt: Install Oil Filter Element Service Hole Cover

s2.ptxt: As shown in the illustration, fold the service hole cover toward the top of the vehicle, then unfold the crease.

atten4.ptxt: If the crease is not unfolded, the service hole cover may appear raised after installation.
